features: HI-DEFINITION AUDIO: Experience rich, crystal-clear sound with enhanced detail, delivering an immersive listening experience for music, movies, and gaming.
BUILT-IN DAC CHIP: Advanced DAC chip ensures precise digital-to-analog conversion, reproducing every note with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
INSTANT PLUG & PLAY: Connect and enjoy instantly without drivers or software, delivering seamless performance right out of the box.
MIC & AUDIO SUPPORT: Supports both microphone input and audio output, enabling crystal-clear calls, voice chats, online meetings, and uninterrupted entertainment.
PREMIUM BRAIDED CABLE: Durable braided construction resists tangles and everyday wear, ensuring reliable performance and long-lasting durability.
description: Enjoy high-quality audio with the Zebronics CTAux 10 Type-C to 3.5mm Audio Adapter. Featuring a built-in DAC chip, it delivers high-definition sound while supporting both microphone and audio functions for calls and entertainment. The plug-and-play design ensures instant usability, while the tangle-free braided cable, sleek flexible construction, and premium aluminum body provide lasting durability and everyday convenience. Compatible with a wide range of Type-C smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other supported devices, the Zeb CTAux 10 is a reliable audio companion for work and entertainment.
